descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Welcome to GO CLUBBING™

Experience live DJs, discover artists and meet friends in immersive music venues on Meta Quest. Explore clubs, poolside parties and spectacular stages beyond Earth, with social avatars and performances bringing people together.

## Explore the venues

### The Underground

Discover emerging artists, with dual screens and two live streams bringing audiences closer to the performance.

[media]

### The Mars Dome

Spectacular immersive shows, with music-reactive graphics wrapping around the dome, showcasing big tracks, DJ mixes and performances.

[media]

### The Pool Party

Enjoy the music and a poolside party with friends.

[media]

### The Far Side of the Moon

Perform or watch a gig on the Moon, with a lunar stage for bands and live music.

[media]

### The Sunset Bar

Meet friends, enjoy the music and unwind as the sun goes down.

[media]

### The Time Machine

Relive great shows and rediscover memorable music and artists.

[media]

### The Arch

A small, intimate club with pumping music and up-close performances.

[media]

### Infinite Stage

Immersive 360° shows, with performances unfolding all around you.

[media]

## Music brings us together

Explore with friends, discover new artists and enjoy a growing world of virtual entertainment. Live performances and programming vary by venue and schedule.
